description.value:
Normalized Bad Eden ancestry. This item keeps the original species UUID while fitting the ancestry-root layer of the new identity stack.

Species (Bad Eden). Forged by ash squalls and monsoon flats, Stormborn wander where others won’t. They read skies, ride fronts, and shelter a caravan like a moving city.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Stormborn).
  • Size. You are Medium.
  • Speed. Your walking speed is 30 feet.
  • Weatherwise. You gain proficiency with the Survival skill. You ignore nonmagical difficult terrain caused by weather (such as mud from heavy rain, shallow snow, or high winds).
  • Ward of the Gale. Once per long rest, when you would take environmental damage (such as from a storm, heat, or similar hazard), you can use your reaction to reduce that damage to half until the start of your next turn.
  • Nomad Networks. You learn one additional language of your choice and have advantage on ability checks to locate water, shelter, or safe passage in Desert / Ash Wastes or Swamp / Mire hexes.
  • Ability Scores. Your Archetype determines your ability score increases; Stormborn Nomad does not grant any ability score bonuses.

Strategic Hooks (Foundry / Bad Eden)

“You are the difference between ‘we crossed the wastes’ and ‘someone found the bones later.’”

  • OP Edge. Your faction gains +2 Non-Lethal OP and +1 Faith OP at campaign start.
  • Hex Synergy. In Desert / Ash Wastes or Swamp / Mire hexes, your traveling party ignores the first hazard triggered per Strategic Turn.
  • Purifying Rites. Once per Strategic Turn, you may perform a 10-minute rite. If the group succeeds on a DC 15 group check (as set by the GM), you reduce regional Darkness by 1; this costs 1 Faith OP.

Ward of the Gale
Recovery: 1/long rest  ·  Action: Reaction (on environmental damage)
Reduce environmental damage (storm, heat, hazard) to half until the start of your next turn.
